wikibasebootstrap-desc: Validates and applies bootstrap ontology bundles to empty Wikibase instances
ontologybootstrap-summary: Set up a new Wikibase with a small, reviewed foundation of properties. Choose a bundle below to create its initial ontology. A bundle can only be applied before Wikibase has entities, and nothing changes until you explicitly confirm it.
ontologybootstrap-invalid-token: Your session token was invalid. Please try again.
ontologybootstrap-not-empty: This Wikibase has active entities and cannot be bootstrapped. Reset it first; bootstrap bundles are never merged into existing entity data.
ontologybootstrap-existing-summary: You can only bootstrap an empty Wikibase.
ontologybootstrap-reset-invitation: It looks like your Wikibase is still relatively small with only $1 {{PLURAL:$1|item|items}} and $2 {{PLURAL:$2|property|properties}}. If you'd like to start over with one of the bootstrapped ontologies below, you need to first delete all existing Wikibase entities.
ontologybootstrap-existing-warning: If you'd like to delete all of your current items and properties, you can do so below. Wiki pages, user accounts, and deletion history will not be deleted.
ontologybootstrap-complete: Bootstrap applied successfully: $1 properties were created.
ontologybootstrap-reset-permission: You do not have permission to reset Wikibase entities.
ontologybootstrap-reset-confirm-intro: To delete all of your existing Wikibase $1 entities, type:
ontologybootstrap-reset-confirm-required: Type DELETE $1 ENTITIES exactly before deleting this batch.
ontologybootstrap-reset-progress: Deleted up to $1 entities. $2 active entities remain; repeat the confirmed reset if needed.
ontologybootstrap-reset-too-many: Ontology bootstrapping is only available for a new Wikibase. To protect this existing Wikibase, it cannot be reset here once it contains more than $1 entities.
ontologybootstrap-ready-to-apply: This empty Wikibase is eligible. Apply $1 properties from the selected bundle.
